changes_under_test: Unmodified benchmark targets at latest pulled revision. Local compact.rs UI edit is unrelated to these targets; layout optimization is set aside.
profile: release, thin LTO, codegen-units=1, locked dependencies
conditions: Sequential workloads after builds finish; Emulsion closed. Normal desktop background services remain active. No thermal control.
limitations: Component workloads, not OS input-to-screen latency.
GPU workloads require hardware initialization; skip messages are treated as failures.
RAW memory fields using /proc are unavailable on macOS; external time -l records process maximum RSS in bytes.
All measurements establish baselines for the latest pulled revision; older Mac results are historical.
Default photo development only: AI sensor denoise, HDR, panorama, depth effects, catalog browsing and UI switching are not benchmarked.
Diagram command benchmark uses orthogonal connectors; viewport/GPU benchmarks use straight connectors. Those timings are distinct workloads.
No latest-Linux rerun on matching hardware was available.
